title: adenostyles alpina var. macrocephala
intro: Adenostyles alpina var. macrocephala, commonly known as Alpine Hawk's Beard, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family, characterized by its hairy stems and yellow flowers. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Hawk's Beard include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it a potential treatment for various infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of Adenostyles alpina var. macrocephala include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
